title: Aimbot ESP AND MORE OPPPP
features:
Enable Aimbot — locks/smoothly aims at nearest enemy
Aim Lock — instant snap vs smooth lerp mode
Team Check — skip teammates
Wall Check — only aim through visible targets
Target Part — Head / HumanoidRootPart / UpperTorso
Smoothness slider — 0 = instant, 10 = very slow lerp
FOV Radius slider — how wide the aimbot searches
Trigger Bot — auto fires when crosshair is on an enemy
Trigger Delay slider — ms before it pulls the trigger

VISUALS

Enable ESP — master toggle for all ESP
Box ESP — 2D boxes around enemies
Name ESP — player names above their head
Tracers — lines from bottom of screen to each enemy
Chams — highlight glow through walls
Rainbow ESP — all ESP elements cycle RGB colors
Show FOV — draws the aimbot FOV circle on screen
ESP Team Check — hide teammates from ESP
RGB Speed slider — how fast the rainbow cycles
Crosshair Size slider — custom crosshair drawn on screen

EXPLOITS

Rapid Fire — zeros all fire delay/cooldown values, forces full auto, persistent
Fire Delay slider — how low the fire rate gets
Infinite Ammo — keeps all ammo values at 999999
No Recoil — zeroes all recoil and spread values
Speed Hack — overrides WalkSpeed every frame
WalkSpeed slider — 16 to 100
Fly — free camera-direction flight with WASD + Space/Ctrl
Fly Speed slider — 10 to 200
NoClip — disables collision every stepped tick
